test_title: PYST 38: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'PLIERS' is coded as MMAFJO and 'SHOVEL' is coded as FZRLFR. How will 'WRENCH' be coded in the same language?
solution:
The Position and Positional value of English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

For, 'PLIERS' is coded as MMAFJO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a9a91dfa916106cd8767fa05d97aedffd4be5ed839ec2f276cb220871a92b77.png] 

For, 'SHOVEL' is coded as FZRLFR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad157e728c13ea2491ff688c9d1ec06684cf761ab5f63955d800d5d2df3b614c.png] 

Similarly,** 'WRENCH'** will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bae132f31e4df1a5097f540b60f68d0ef20801da32f04606091004c41e97a21.png] 

So, **'WRENCH'** will be written as **'BXJBPV'.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
